sql_asli_1baris: WITH latest_target_year AS ( SELECT MAX(tahun) AS tahun_terbaru FROM target_balai ), laporan_dikirim AS ( SELECT mp.nama_balai, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) AS tahun, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan FROM mv_pengawasan mp WHERE mp.tgl_start IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY mp.nama_balai, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) ) SELECT ld.nama_balai, ld.komoditi, ld.tahun AS tahun_laporan, tb.tahun AS tahun_target, ld.jumlah_laporan, tb.target_pengawasan, ROUND( (ld.jumlah_laporan::decimal / NULLIF(tb.target_pengawasan, 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS capaian_persen FROM laporan_dikirim ld CROSS JOIN latest_target_year lty LEFT JOIN target_balai tb ON LOWER(TRIM(tb.nama_balai)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.nama_balai)) AND LOWER(TRIM(tb.komoditi)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.komoditi)) AND tb.tahun = lty.tahun_terbaru ORDER BY ld.nama_balai, ld.komoditi;
sql_dipakai_1baris: WITH latest_target_year AS ( SELECT MAX(tahun) AS tahun_terbaru FROM target_balai ), laporan_dikirim AS ( SELECT mp.nama_balai, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) AS tahun, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan FROM mv_pengawasan mp WHERE mp.tgl_start IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY mp.nama_balai, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) ) SELECT ld.nama_balai, ld.komoditi, ld.tahun AS tahun_laporan, tb.tahun AS tahun_target, ld.jumlah_laporan, tb.target_pengawasan, ROUND( (ld.jumlah_laporan::decimal / NULLIF(tb.target_pengawasan, 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS capaian_persen FROM laporan_dikirim ld CROSS JOIN latest_target_year lty LEFT JOIN target_balai tb ON LOWER(TRIM(tb.nama_balai)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.nama_balai)) AND LOWER(TRIM(tb.komoditi)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.komoditi)) AND tb.tahun = lty.tahun_terbaru ORDER BY ld.nama_balai, ld.komoditi;

sql_asli_1baris: WITH data_penilaian AS ( SELECT mp.nama_balai, UPPER(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) AS kesimpulan_penilaian, COUNT(*) AS jumlah FROM mv_pengawasan mp WHERE LOWER(mp.komoditi) LIKE '%pangan%' AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat IS NOT NULL AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mp.nama_balai, UPPER(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) ) SELECT dp.nama_balai, dp.kesimpulan_penilaian, dp.jumlah, ROUND( (dp.jumlah::decimal / NULLIF(SUM(dp.jumlah) OVER (PARTITION BY dp.nama_balai), 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS persentase FROM data_penilaian dp ORDER BY dp.nama_balai, persentase DESC;
sql_dipakai_1baris: WITH data_penilaian AS ( SELECT mp.nama_balai, UPPER(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) AS kesimpulan_penilaian, COUNT(*) AS jumlah FROM mv_pengawasan mp WHERE LOWER(mp.komoditi) LIKE '%pangan%' AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat IS NOT NULL AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mp.nama_balai, UPPER(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) ) SELECT dp.nama_balai, dp.kesimpulan_penilaian, dp.jumlah, ROUND( (dp.jumlah::decimal / NULLIF(SUM(dp.jumlah) OVER (PARTITION BY dp.nama_balai), 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS persentase FROM data_penilaian dp ORDER BY dp.nama_balai, persentase DESC;
